name: ABC Afterschool Special
description: Dramatically presented situations, often controversial, of interest to children and teenagers. Several episodes were either in animated form or presented as documentaries. Topics included illiteracy, substance abuse and teenage pregnancy.

videos.title: Afterschool Special Clip Reel of the Stars' Highlighted Moments
William
videos.overview: Introduces William Shakespeare to young people through sketches, readings and music.

videos.title: The Incredible, Indelible Magical, Physical Mystery Trip
videos.overview: A partially-animated special about two youngsters who are miniaturized, then travel through their Uncle's body to understand more about his health.

videos.title: My Dad Lives in a Downtown Hotel
videos.overview: Divorce, as seen through the eyes of a young boy. The youngster - whose father has been ordered out of the house and is forced to take up permanent residence in a downtown hotel - is traumatized by the imminent divorce, and it is up to his loved ones to help him cope.

videos.title: Pssst! Hammerman's After You
videos.overview: A small-for-his-age sixth-grade student and his wild attempts to flee a bully after word gets around he thinks of him as a Neanderthal.

videos.title: The Magical Mystery Trip Through Little Red's Head
videos.overview: Two youngsters are shrunk so they can enter their teenage sister's head, and discover how the mind works.

videos.title: Winning and Losing: Diary of a Campaign
The Secret Life of T.K. Dearing
It Must Be Love ('Cause I Feel So Dumb)
The Amazing Cosmic Awareness of Duffy Moon
videos.overview: This cute story centers around an insecure 6th grader, Duffy Moon (played by Ike Eisenmann), whose discovery of ""Cosmic Awareness"" leads him on a journey to self-discovery and confidence that he can do anything.

videos.title: Dear Lovey Hart: I Am Desperate
Francesca, Baby
videos.overview: Semi-standard ABC Afterschool Special about Francesca James, a teenage daughter dealing with her alcoholic mother through the support group Ala-Teen.

videos.title: P.J. and the President's Son
videos.overview: Update of Mark Twain's The Prince and the Pauper. Delivery boy and President's son discover they are exact doubles of one another, and decide to swap identities.

videos.title: Mighty Moose and the Quarterback Kid
My Mom's Having a Baby
videos.overview: My Mom's Having a Baby is an American television teen comedy/documentary that aired as an ABC Afterschool Special on February 16, 1977. The program would be historic as it was the first television program of its kind in the United States to showcase the pregnancy process and conception to young people, using a combination of animation and live action. The program was a co-production between Dick Clark Productions and DePatie-Freleng Enterprises.

videos.title: The Pinballs
videos.overview: Three diverse kids with different outlooks on life are sent to a foster home until family problems can be worked out.

videos.title: It Isn't Easy Being a Teenage Millionaire
Mom and Dad Can't Hear Me
It's a Mile from Here to Glory
The Seven Wishes of a Rich Kid
Dinky Hocker
videos.overview: Dinky Hocker is an American television teen comedy/drama that aired as an ABC Afterschool Special on December 12, 1979. It was based on the 1972 novel Dinky Hocker Shoots Smack by M.E. Kerr.

videos.title: Where Do Teenagers Come From?
videos.overview: Where Do Teenagers Come From? was an American television teen comedy/documentary that aired as an ABC Afterschool Special on March 5, 1980. The live action/animation program was produced by DePatie-Freleng Enterprises and was a sequel to the 1977 program My Mom's Having a Baby. The special was notable for its signature song "Growing Up," written by Doug Goodwin.

videos.title: A Family of Strangers
videos.overview: A widower's two teen-aged daughters resent their father's remarriage to a single mother, especially since the woman's 12-year-old daughter (who is several years younger) will now compete for the parents attention. This special focuses on the parents' attempts to unite the new stepsisters into a loving family.

videos.title: Schoolboy Father
videos.overview: High school senior discovers his summer girlfriend has given birth to his child, and decides to fight for custody.

videos.title: My Mother Was Never a Kid
videos.overview: My Mother Was Never a Kid is an American television teen fantasy/comedy/drama that aired as an ABC Afterschool Special on March 16, 1981. It was based on the 1977 Francine Pascal novel Hangin' Out With CiCi, which in turn was the first teen novel in the "Victoria Martin" trilogy series. It was also the first of two Pascal teen novels that were adapted into Afterschool Specials for the network, the other being The Hand-Me-Down Kid.

videos.title: She Drinks a Little
videos.overview: ""She Drinks a Little"" ... or does she a lot, lot more? That's what Cindy's friends try to convince her as she denies that her mother may be a flat-out alcoholic. Eventually, Cindy sees that her mother indeed has a serious drinking problem and needs help. This ABC Afterschool Special showcases Alateen, the national support group for teenagers with alcoholic family members.

videos.title: Starstruck
videos.overview: Aspiring teen folk singer is torn whether to continue her singing or to accept an educational scholarship.

videos.title: Tough Girl
videos.overview: After juvenile delinquent Renie Lake is caught dealing drugs in a stolen van, she is court ordered to live with her father and rigid step-family. Despite living with a family that seems to dislike her, she re-enrolls in High School and befriends a hearing-impaired girl.

videos.title: The Color of Friendship
videos.overview: The Color of Friendship is a 1981 film shown as part of the ABC Afterschool Special series. It's about the friendship between two 13-year-old boys, one black and one white, in a small town that has just started integrating its schools.

videos.title: Sometimes I Don't Love My Mother
Two Loves for Jenny
videos.overview: A teen violinist is torn between her musical career and her boyfriend. (Also knowns as "Between Two Loves")

videos.title: Please Don't Hit Me, Mom
videos.overview: Please Don't Hit Me, Mom is a TV episode that was nominated for Outstanding Children's Program in the 34th Primetime Emmy Awards.

videos.title: Have You Ever Been Ashamed of Your Parents?
The Wave
videos.overview:
The Wave, is a short made-for-TV movie directed by Alex Grasshoff, based on Ron Jones' The Third Wave experiment. Though more prominently featured as an episode of the ABC Afterschool Special series, this show debuted October 4, 1981, almost two years before being featured in the Afterschool Special series.

It starred Bruce Davison as the teacher Ben Ross, a character based on Jones.

A novelization of the film The Wave, was released in the same year. Ron Jones' writings and Johnny Dawkins' screenplay were also basis of the 2008 German film The Wave

videos.title: It's No Crush, I'm in Love
The Dog Days of Arthur Cane
The Hero Who Couldn't Read
videos.overview: Teacher discovers that the star basketball player is illiterate, and makes it his mission to teach him how to read.

videos.title: The Celebrity and the Arcade Kid
videos.overview: Video-arcade whiz and teen movie star discover they are exact doubles and decide to switch identities.

videos.title: Out of Step
videos.overview: An aspiring teenager Lisa dancer gets the chance to try out for a dance troupe. But will fear of failure keep her from auditioning? Terry Donahoe stars as Lisa Williams.

videos.title: The Almost Royal Family
videos.overview: The Almost Royal Family is an American television teen comedy that aired as an ABC Afterschool Special on October 23, 1984. The program was based on the 1973 novel Meanwhile, Back At the Castle, by Hope Campbell.

videos.title: One Too Many
videos.overview: Four high school friends find their lives changed forever when one of the friends drives drunk with devastating results.

videos.title: Cindy Eller: A Modern Fairy Tale
Don't Touch
videos.overview: A teen-aged girl named Karen Anderson suspects that Molly Stewart, the 6-year-old girl she is baby-sitting, is behaving quite strangely around an adult friend of the Stewarts. Turns out that the man is likely molesting Molly. Karen tries to bring the matter to the Stewarts' attention, but they only take action when it is almost too late. This special takes a look at child molestation and explores the warning signs people should notice.

videos.title: Wanted: The Perfect Guy
videos.overview: A teen-aged boy and his girlfriend secretly place personal ads for his divorced mother, Ellie, in an effort to find Mr. Right. The two screen potential dates, but none of them seem right for Ellie. In the end, it is Ellie who finds the man who she deems ""the perfect guy.

videos.title: Read Between the Lines
videos.overview: When an illiterate toy maker has the right to his invention stolen, his grandson and the Harlem Globetrotters team up to get them back.

videos.title: Just a Regular Kid: An AIDS Story
The Kid Who Wouldn't Quit: The Brad Silverman Story
The Day My Kid Went Punk
The Terrible Things My Mother Told Me
videos.overview: Terrible Things My Mother Told Me is a 1988 TV film starring Nicole Andrews, Ita DeMarco, Carol Goodheart, Beth Howland and Stephen James. This TV film is about a 16-year-old girl who doesn't realize that her mother is emotionally and verbally abusive to her. It was directed by Susan Rohrer and written by John Alan Palmer, Christopher Whitesell and Susan Rohrer. It aired on ABC.

videos.title: Tattle: When to Tell on a Friend
Just Tipsy, Honey
videos.overview: A teenage girl is in total denial about her mother's drinking problem.

videos.title: The Cheats
videos.overview: Three girls steal the answers to their final exam. When the headmistress finds out, she gives those responsible one-day to confess. After that anyone participating in the cover-up will be expelled.

videos.title: My Dad Can't Be Crazy, Can He?
videos.overview: A 16-year-old high school student tries to cope with his schizophrenic father's behavior, which takes its toll on his schoolwork, activities and reputation.

videos.title: Over the Limit
videos.overview: High school student Matt Thompson (Keith Coogan) must decide whether or not to come forward with the truth about a tragic drunk-driving accident. Co-starring Sam Rockwell.

videos.title: The Perfect Date
videos.overview: A 16-year-old student is convinced his upcoming date with the school prom queen will be the perfect date. However it turns out to be anything but the perfect date.

videos.title: A Question About Sex
videos.overview: A Question About Sex is a TV episode of ABC Afterschool Special.

videos.title: Stood Up
videos.overview: A teen-aged girl attempts to get even with her boyfriend who stood her up on prom night by suing him for the cost of the dress. When the small claims court docket is full, she takes her case to a high school student court.

videos.title: Montana Crossroads
videos.overview: An art student enters the breach between her controlling mother and her stubborn, aging grandfather during a stay at her grandfather's Montana ranch.

videos.title: I Hate the Way I Look
Boys Will Be Boys
videos.overview: A high-school sophomore has her reputation tarnished by some male students who scrawl malicious graffiti about her in the boys' restroom.

videos.title: Bonnie Raitt Has Something to Talk About
Magical Make-Over
videos.overview: Teenage girl desperately wants to be popular. One day an angel grants her that wish, by giving her a new image every day. But soon she wishes she could just be herself.

videos.title: Positive: A Journey Into AIDS
videos.overview: Positive: A Journey Into AIDS is a 1995 documentary directed by Eamon Harrington and John Watkin. It was produced for the ABC Afterschool Special series. It followed actors Michael Sutton and Kimberly McCullough, who played Stone Cates and Robin Scorpio, respectively, as they researched HIV and AIDS for their roles as HIV+ teenagers on the long-running ABC daytime serial General Hospital.

videos.title: Just Chill
videos.overview: After the senseless death of his twin brother, a teen drug pusher decides to seek revenge against all who have wronged him in the neighborhood.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 91 wins & 158 nominations total
